questions_before_times: What kind of piano: an upright, a spinet, a grand or a baby grand? Acoustic only (digital pianos are not tuned)
The brand, and about how old it is
When was it last tuned? (more than a year can mean a pitch raise)
Was it moved lately? (a moved piano needs about 2 weeks to settle)
Is anything wrong: sticking keys, a buzz, a broken string?
safety_stop: A piano that tipped over or fell, or anyone hurt or pinned by one
Smoke, flames, sparks or a burning smell from the piano's humidity heater, a lamp or an outlet; or a gas smell
license: Most states don't license piano tuning or repair. Some register repair businesses, and some cities want a business license: the state's or city's form says. Safe default: the business registration on file, shown on the listing.
